findings.detail: The extracted 5.00% spread is from the December 31, 2025 comparative schedule; the March 31, 2026 spread is 4.75%.

rationale: The flagged identifier reports S + 5.00% for the 2026-03-31 Barbri position, but the current-period schedule at table 12 row 25 reports S + 4.75%.
